Taffy browsing and saved-flow scenes
====================================

Owner: Matterward Labs Private Limited / TaffyGo
Licence: Reserved media, not licensed with the code; see TRADEMARKS.md.
Created: 2026-09-09
Generator: Codex built-in image_gen; original prompts, no input assets.
Masters: vendor/task-scenes/masters/ (unaltered generated PNGs, 1448 by 1086).
Shipping: src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/ (640 by 480 WebP).
Encoder: cwebp -q 84 -m 6 -resize 640 480 -metadata none

Original editorial gouache scenes commissioned for TaffyGo. The browsing
scene is a person comparing two abstract phone cards; the saved-flow scene
is a person's hands arranging three simple cards beside a phone and ribbon.
The local Aster Premium, Web to App and WhatsApp Business pages informed the
use of warm painted narrative imagery and category colour. No Aster image,
mascot, third-party asset, site screenshot or personal document was copied.

These are decorative, inert plates beside existing text. They do not depict
current task state, price comparisons, permissions or successful outcomes.
Live tab previews retain their browser-owned images. The welcome art leaves
with the existing welcome when typing starts; larger text uses the full
width for copy and controls. No network fetch or image inspection is involved.

Prompts: the exact built-in generation briefs are kept in the maintainer's
working tree (task-scenes/prompts.md there) and are not published.
Replace by generating a new reviewed master and encoding it with the same
recipe, then update both checksums. Never edit only the shipping bytes.
